surveyedSource: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012241531 ring (RD, PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) in native east/south metres above the 3DBAG ground (scripts/landmarks/noorderparkbad-footprints.json, written by pool-site-prepare.ts, with the OSM basin outlines a1009154122-a1009154130, ODbL). Fronts read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0: TMX7316010203-000876_pano_0000_003023, recording_2024-10-22_11-23-02_01905, TMX7316010203-000876_pano_0000_001230, TMX7316010203-002182_pano_0000_000435); basins, decks and the chute from the PDOK luchtfoto 2025 (Beeldmateriaal Nederland, CC BY 4.0). Per item in scripts/landmarks/noorderparkbad-inventory.json.

attribution.title: Noorderparkbad, Noorderpark: indoor bath of 2015 with outdoor basins
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) and the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0): the striped brick walls, the deep eave band, NOORDERPARKBAD in red brick letters along the curved north wall, the glazed entrance between the N and diamond-lattice piers, and the five outdoor basins with their decks and the covered chute. Basin outlines from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) checked on the PDOK luchtfoto (CC BY 4.0); fronts read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
